name: Пішакова структура (1)
description:
From the bronze level onwards, the number of strategic themes will be expanded. One of the most important strategic themes is pawn structure. âPawn structureâ is the way in which the pawns are arranged on the board. In the beginning, this structure consists of a long chain. This structure can change during the course of the game. After pawns are captured, the structure can be affected. The long chain suddenly changes into multiple âislandsâ.

Many different pawn formations have also been given their own names. Well-known examples are doubled pawns, isolated pawns, backward pawns and hanging pawns. In this lesson, we will first focus on the doubled pawns. A âdoubled pawnâ occurs when two pawns of the same color are on the same file. In many positions, double pawns are considered a weakness. The disadvantage of double pawns is that they get in each otherâs way and, above all, that they cannot protect each other. Double pawns are therefore less flexible.

In this lesson, your task is to saddle your opponent with a doubled pawn. You can sometimes achieve this by exchanging pieces on a specific square, forcing your opponent to recapture with a pawn.

What do you have to do?

Saddle your opponent with a doubled pawn by exchanging on a strategic square.

examples.text: Шляхом розміну на f6 білі можуть змусити чорних отримати подвоєного пішака. Тепер позиція чорного короля послаблена.

texts: Коли чорні знову беруть, чорні залишаються з подвоєними пішаками d-шахів.
The black king's position is now hopelessly weakened.
White gets saddled with doubled f-pawns and the d-pawn becomes isolated.
Black ends up with two isolated doubled a-pawns, and the c-pawn also becomes isolated.
Black gets a doubled e-pawn. Moreover, the black bishop loses scope and the c-pawn becomes isolated.
Black gets doubled pawns on the f-file and the king is weakened.
